To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The bioluminescence characteristics of the double mutants of aequorins were investigated and the results showed that the emission properties of the double mutants were changed compared to the wild type protein.

The Y82F/W 86F double mutant showed the longest light half-life, and Y82F/D 153G double mutant showed highest stability against thermal denaturation, and W86/F double mutant showed highest thermostability.
The Y82F mutation in the binding pocket of the apoaequorins results in a shift of emission to the longer wavelengths while W86F mutation results in a shift to the shorter wavelengths.

the development of new variants of aequorins which are more stable against heat shock, have longer light emission, and can be used in different applications.
